rounds.text: A calm blue palette for a banking app should feel steady and trustworthy, so I've kept the blues deep and muted, with a soft slate secondary and a light sky accent for highlights. The primary blue carries buttons and links, the near-navy ink carries body text, and the pale blue-white surface keeps screens airy. Each text pairing shows its own contrast rating on the card, so check those against AA before you adopt them.
